units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:12">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 12</cite> (cmp.
Koh. R. to III, 2 ולמה … לה ח׳ וכ׳ and why do they call her ḥay’tha? Because she was dying and is recovering.—3) midwife.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:6:3">Y. Keth. V, 30ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00940"><he>חֲכַם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:3">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> (prov.) <he>בין ח׳ למחבלתא וכ׳</he> between the midwife and the travailing woman, the child of the poor woman dies.—Pl. <cite ref="H00750"><he>חַיָּיתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00649"><he>חַיָּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 1:15">Targ. Ex. I, 15</cite>.—Y. Sabb. XIII, end, 16ᶜ <he>שאלון לח׳</he> ask the midwives (about their usages on the Sabbath); <he>אמרה ליה ליכא חַיָּיא</he> said she to him, there is no midwife (in the place).
